section_summary.evidence_source: 2.4 Participants A convenience sample of 204 participants was recruited (163 women and 41 men) whose mean age was 28.96 (SD = 10.27). A questionnaire was administered which included sociodemographic information and gratitude, loneliness, social desirability, subjective happiness and life satisfaction measures. Participants were guaranteed anonymity. For the present study, 100% of the respondents filled in the complete questionnaire without missing data. The sample size was considered acceptable because one common rule of thumb is to ensure a person-to-item ratio of 10:1.
